question: Which filmmaker won the Best Screenplay award at the Venice film festival for ‘The Disciple’, a Marathi drama, in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Chaitanya Tamhane.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Filmmaker **Chaitanya Tamhane's The Disciple** won the best Best Screenplay award at Venice International Film Festival during the closing ceremony held on 12 September 2020.
 
• This is the second award the film got at the festival. Earlier, it was honoured with** the International Critics' Prize awarded by FIPRESCI.**
 
• **Chloe Zhao's Nomadland won the prestigious Golden Lion award at the festival.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Disciple is a** Marathi movie** directed by Chaitanya Tamhane. Its plot is based on **Indian Classical Music.**
 
• The Disciple was also selected as the only Indian film this year among the official selection of the** 2020 Toronto International Film Festival.**
 
• The film unfolds with the story of a young musician Sharad, the disciple who has been initiated into the rites of Hindustani classical music complete with reverence and idealism.
 
 
• **Director: Chaitanya Tamhane.**
 
• **Writer: Chaitanya Tamhane.**
 
• **Stars: Aditya Modak, Arun Dravid, Sumitra Bhave**
